name: Example Contributing Process
summary: Template for a protocol extension that adds processes while it runs.
description: A repository-ready AfterNight extension package for the Lite host that keeps a catalogue of its own - two scripts a person may enable - and states the enabled ones as processes, which AfterNight lists in the extension's menu, the palette, the recent processes and the favourites. A session started for one of them reads which from its session.
author: Example Author
